disposition_reason: Table 3 prints per-sample As, Cd, Hg and Pb readings (ppb) for 18 whey and vegan protein powders from China, Japan and India, though the unit basis is unclear.

study.design: 18 commercial whey and vegan protein powder sachets (3 whey + 3 vegan from each of China, Japan, India), triplicate digestion
study.origin: China, Japan and India (country of product source as stated)
study.market: sourced from an India, China and Japan nutraceutical export exhibition
study.method: Q-ICP-MS (Agilent 7800, helium mode) after microwave digestion (0.2 g, HNO3/HCl, 160 °C), Rh internal standard
study.lod_text: LOD (µg/L): As 0.7, Cd 0.9, Hg 0.8, Pb 6.9; LOQ (µg/L): As 2.4, Cd 3, Hg 4, Pb 23 (Table 4)
study.qa: Spike recoveries at 10, 50, 100 µg/kg: As 110, Cd 106, Hg 104, Pb 115% (Table 4); CRMs said to be analysed with each batch but results not printed
